summary: Implement transparent browser-automation fallback for reports create command when Concur v4 API rejects pure HTTP requests with policyId required error. Amended twice same-day: once for a live-reproduced blocking interstitial dialog, once for two P1 code-review findings (silent wrong-region fallback, and an unqualified error after an irreversible Create Report click that risked duplicate reports).
reason: Live Concur v4 API rejects report creation on some tenants with HTTP 400 policyId is required, because these tenants require explicit policy assignment, but the CLI does not expose any policy IDs to callers. Following the established template of hotels_search.go, this patch auto-detects specifically this error shape and transparently retries by driving a browser via agent-browser to submit the Create Report dialog. Amendment 1 (same day): a live end-to-end run surfaced a second real bug in this same fallback -- a one-time-per-session promotional interstitial dialog (observed: "We've updated the hotel booking experience.") can render on top of the Create Report modal and silently block the Create Report click. Fixed by mirroring hotels_search.go's overlay-clearing step (a plain "close" button click), with an Escape-key fallback added after live testing showed the close-button click alone can report success without actually dismissing the dialog. Amendment 2 (same day, PR code review): two P1 findings. (a) The host-derivation logic silently defaulted to "us2.concursolutions.com" whenever it couldn't confirm the API base URL was a concursolutions.com host -- for a real tenant on a different region, or behind a supported proxy/custom endpoint, this opens the WRONG Concur UI (can fail auth, or target a different tenant's context). Fixed via resolveReportsUIHost: derive the host only from a base URL that's actually concursolutions.com or a subdomain, honor an explicit CONCUR_UI_BASE_URL override unconditionally, and hard-error rather than guess otherwise. (b) The irreversible Create Report click could be followed by a plain, retry-looking error if waitForReportID or the follow-up GET failed -- a caller retrying reports create after that error risks creating a duplicate report in a real financial system. Fixed via reportsCreatePartialSuccessError, which every error path after the click now returns, explicitly warning that a report may already exist (with its ID, when known) and pointing at reports get/reports list instead of a blind retry.

changes.description: Updated reports create execution path to catch 400 policyId validation error, transparently invoke agent-browser fallback, and retrieve the newly created report details. Amended same-day to dismiss a blocking interstitial dialog before the Create Report click (close-button click first, matching hotels_search.go's overlay-clearing convention, Escape as fallback). Amended again for code review: host derivation now goes through resolveReportsUIHost (trusted-host derivation or explicit CONCUR_UI_BASE_URL override only, hard error otherwise -- never a silent region guess); every error path after the irreversible Create Report click now returns reportsCreatePartialSuccessError instead of a plain error.

Mock-based unit tests covering: policyId required error triggering browser fallback, other 400 errors surfacing unchanged, successful HTTP creation never triggering browser fallback, an interstitial dismissed by a single close-button click (Escape asserted NOT called), an interstitial requiring the Escape fallback (asserted called), resolveReportsUIHost's derivation/override/error-not-guess behavior across 6 cases (including a second region to prove it isn't hardcoded to us2), and reportsCreatePartialSuccessError's message content and errors.Is unwrapping with and without a known report ID. All pre-existing scenarios updated to set CONCUR_UI_BASE_URL, since the test server's host is deliberately untrusted by resolveReportsUIHost's new behavior.

validated_outcome: Unit tests pass across all scenarios: the original 3 (direct HTTP success, other HTTP 400, policyId-required fallback), 2 interstitial scenarios (dismissed by close click; requiring Escape fallback), 6 resolveReportsUIHost cases, and 1 reportsCreatePartialSuccessError case (2 sub-checks). Full module test suite (go test ./...) passes with zero regressions after each of the three amendments. Live end-to-end run same day: created and submitted a real report against the actual tenant via this exact fallback path (amendments 1 and the original patch); amendment 2's fixes were driven by PR code-review findings rather than a second live run, verified via the unit-test harness described above plus go build/go vet.

deferred_to_upstream.feature: Generic auto-detect-and-fallback-to-browser for any printed CLI mutation that live-fails on a tenant-config-dependent required field the generator has no way to discover ahead of time (this instance: Concur's policyId on report creation).
deferred_to_upstream.reason: Only observed once so far (this concur-pp-cli instance). Kept CLI-specific rather than opening a cli-printing-press generator issue on a single data point; noting the pattern here so a second independent sighting has a paper trail to point back to before generalizing.
